boxes.title: Kumaragiri & Anavema: more
items: Anavema danas guided by **Vemadri Pandit**; minister **Mamidi Peddanamatya**, chief **Chennamanayaka**
**Senani Mallareddy** restored **Amareswara** temple; Kandukur attack repelled (**1398**)

head: Who

rows: First ruler of division; died young

boxes.title: Administration & taxes
items: Paid in **Manyam** land or crop share (**Mera**)
Kanika: gifts; **Pullari**: grazing; **Illari**: house; **Ari**: land tax
Motupalli epigraph: tariffs; sandal, camphor, ivory, pearls, pepper ...; **Kakatiyas**: cloth exporters

boxes.title: Religion & society
items: **Vadagalai** matha at **Ahobilam**; Kumaragiri, Kataya Vema = Vaishnava
**Vasatulas** at Ahobilam, Srisailam (Prolaya Vema); Anavemagiri mandapas, **Simhachalam**
Castes: Kammas, Kapus, Reddis, Velamas; **Komatis** traders
